method.pixel_review: Every one of the 49 assigned PNGs was individually opened as a full image with view_image. All 27 axis recaptures, the later degenerate CLT/publication recaptures, and finally all 17 concise-option/caption recaptures were individually re-viewed. No contact-sheet or metadata-only acceptance.
method.display_resolution: view_image resizes long images to a maximum displayed height of 2048px. The stray-zero detail was also read in a full-size crop. Final disputed-caption, degenerate/publication and all 17 final concise-option images were viewed as lossless full-image pixel crops under /tmp with hash-specific names.
method.metadata: Dimensions read from original PNG IHDR; SHA-256 computed from entire original bytes. All 49 hashes and dimensions reverified after final review. Unaffected 32 hashes were explicitly compared with previous reviewed hashes.
method.recapture_acceptance: All 49 entries reflect current original PNG bytes. The final 17 changed stage images were individually reviewed after forced regeneration; the other 32 assigned images retain their previously verified actual pixel reviews and unchanged hashes. Both Uniform captions now visibly describe finite support and exact CDF boundaries; all shortened selected options fit fully.
method.coverage: Titles, graphics and chart geometry, mass bars, tables/marginals, axis ticks, inspector exact/approx values, parameter labels/inputs/selects/sliders/presets, explanatory text, equations and bottom trace controls were inspected in each stage capture. Publication headers, hero/demo, chapter/status layout, modal controls and visible counts were inspected.
method.limits: Static desktop screenshot review only. No browser execution, new build, mathematical proof, numerical test, measured contrast audit, human screen-reader testing or physical-device validation was performed.
method.writes: Only documentation/M8_SCREENSHOT_DESKTOP_REVIEW.json was changed in the workspace. Read-only originals were used; temporary pixel crops under /tmp were used for inspection. No source edit, installation or commit.
